current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether the set L = {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64} of 45 distinct positive integers (N=15) can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple i.
IF a valid partition exists, PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition.

current_plan.body:
LOAD the given set L of integers
GENERATE all candidate triples (a, b, c) from L where a + b = c
FILTER candidate triples to keep only those with distinct elements
SEARCH for a collection of 15 disjoint triples that together cover every element of L using backtracking or constraint solving
IF a complete covering is found THEN OUTPUT the 15 triples as the partition
ELSE OUTPUT a statement that no valid partition exists
